title: The Pair Sum Flip
prompt:
**Scenario.** Sum of max(a_i, a_j) over all pairs i < j, n = 200000, values up to 10^9. What is the key insight?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Sort descending; the element at sorted index k is the max for exactly k pairs, contributing a[k]·k

**B)** Use a Fenwick tree over values while inserting elements one by one

**C)** Divide and conquer on the value range

**D)** The sum is (Σa)²/2 — a pure formula

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Contribution counting after sorting: each element is the pair-max with exactly the elements before it. (Fenwick works but re-derives the same counting the hard way.)
